S: Support group shortbread with coffee glaze
the support group meetings the narrator crashes

Brown butter shortbread fingers baked pale and crumbly, drizzled with a strong coffee icing, set out next to the urn on a folding table. Melt 200g butter and cook until nutty brown, then chill until firm again. Heat the oven to 160C. Beat the butter with 100g caster sugar, then mix in 250g plain flour, 50g cornflour and a pinch of salt. Press into a lined 20 x 30cm tin, prick and bake 35 minutes until pale gold. Cut into fingers while warm. Mix 120g icing sugar with 2 tbsp strong cold espresso and drizzle over once cool.
Mixed nuts tossed with butter, brown sugar, cayenne and rosemary, roasted at 170C until glossy.

Puff pastry cases filled with creamy chicken and mushroom, warmed and passed around on trays.
M: the narrator's single-serving life on planes
Chicken thighs braised with onion, garlic and stock, served with buttered rice and peas in neat portions.
Paper Street fried egg and bacon rolls
the falling-apart house on Paper Street

Crispy-edged fried eggs and thick bacon in toasted soft rolls with melted cheddar, hot sauce and a smear of chilli mayo. Fry 8 bacon rashers in a large pan until crisp. Remove and fry 4 eggs in the fat over high heat until the edges are lacy and brown but the yolks are runny. Lay a slice of cheddar on each egg for the last 30 seconds. Split and toast 4 soft rolls. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp hot sauce and spread on the rolls. Fill with bacon and the egg, and add more hot sauce to taste.
W: Dark chocolate melted into hot sweetened cream, poured into small single-serve cups and chilled for three hours until set.
K: the beers upstairs at Lou's Tavern after the fights

An ice-cold lager served with a short glass of bourbon on the side, sipped together or dropped in, with salted peanuts on the bar. Chill 4 cans of lager until icy and 4 pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Pour the lager into the frosted glasses. Pour 30ml bourbon into 4 shot glasses. Drink the shot and chase it with the beer, or drop the shot glass carefully into the beer. Serve with a bowl of salted peanuts. Ginger beer and a squeeze of lime for anyone not drinking.

s.how: Melt 30g butter with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1/2 tsp cayenne, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary and 1 tsp salt. Toss through 350g mixed nuts, spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 12 minutes, stirring halfway. Cool 5 minutes so they crisp.

s.note: Tyler's night job waiting tables at banquets
s.how: Fry 300g diced chicken breast in butter, add 150g sliced mushrooms, then stir in 1 tbsp flour and 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Warm 16 vol-au-vent cases at 180C for 5 minutes, fill them and pass around on a tray.

m.note: the narrator's single-serving life on planes
m.how: Brown 800g chicken thighs, then add 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves. Pour in 500ml chicken stock, cover and simmer 25 minutes. Cook 300g long grain rice, stir through 20g butter and 200g peas. Plate in tidy single portions, like the airline trays.

w.how: Heat 300ml cream with 2 tbsp sugar until steaming. Pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate and stir until smooth. Divide between 4 small cups and chill for 3 hours until set.
